metadata.selection_rule: the sole candidate must have positive mean daily RankIC on the frozen 22-session label, at least 0.95 coverage, and absolute rank correlation below 0.70 versus Alpha158_20, Amihud20HistoricalProxy, and every frozen same-provider price-volume candidate through v2.6
metadata.provider_price_contract: The pinned investment_data Qlib Provider supplies adjusted close values. Ra25 uses only ratios of adjusted closes, so the Provider normalization scale cancels within each exact monthly return.
metadata.formation_policy: For every target calendar month t, compute the arithmetic mean of the four exact adjusted-close monthly returns from t-24, t-36, t-48, and t-60 months. Each source return uses the final available exchange-session close in that source month divided by the final available exchange-session close in its exact preceding calendar month minus one. Require all four returns and both exact calendar months for each return; never bridge a missing month or take a partial mean. The score is constant within target month t and contains no current-month observation.
metadata.holding_policy: Use only the paper-supported one-month horizon: a 22-session forward label, Top 50, n_drop=1, and a 21-session minimum holding period. Do not alter the calendar lags, averaging rule, direction, label, validation segment, or execution contract after viewing results.
metadata.paper_definition: The A-share anomaly technical appendix defines Ra25 as the average stock return in months t-24, t-36, t-48, and t-60 and reports positive high-minus-low return spreads for July 2000 through December 2020. The broader same-calendar-month return pattern originates in Heston and Sadka (2008).
metadata.paper_proxy_difference: The paper forms monthly decile portfolios over a broad A-share universe and reports both equal- and value-weighted high-minus-low spreads. QuantaAlpha uses a point-in-time CSI300 universe, a daily constant-within-month signal, a staggered long-only TopK strategy, and next-session-open execution. The first tradable signal produced inside a target month generally misses that month's first session. This is Ra25-CSI300-LongOnly-Proxy, not a paper replication.

031b3c48bf7fb29b.factor_description: Arithmetic mean of the stock's exact same-calendar-month adjusted returns two, three, four, and five years before the target month. Higher scores identify stronger historical same-month returns.
031b3c48bf7fb29b.factor_formulation: Ra25(t) = mean(R(t-24), R(t-36), R(t-48), R(t-60)); R(m) = last_adj_close(m) / last_adj_close(m-1) - 1; all four exact source returns required

metadata.hypothesis: Within the point-in-time CSI300 universe, stocks with higher average returns in the same calendar month two through five years earlier have higher returns over the target month.

feedback.reason: The sole candidate, exact calendar lags, complete-observation rule, direction, period, label, and execution contract were frozen before its factor values, RankIC, forward returns, cache, or strategy result were produced.

consistency_check.reason: A positive arithmetic mean of the four exact paper lags aligns higher scores with the paper-supported long-high-Ra25 direction, while the complete-observation rule prevents missing calendar months from being silently bridged or imputed.
